ClientResponses.Response: Hi Joe, we are very sorry to hear about your burner issue! If your burner tube has corrosion damage, even after cleaning you would not be able to see even flame across your burner tube. Results.ReviewText: We had this exact same grill for years and recently got a second one. I notice the flame is too high/hot even in the lowest setting. Webber sent us a new regulator, but that didn't seem to improve it much. Because I can't trust the temp to hold at 400 degrees, I have to monitor the grilling so if it tries to shoot up to 500 degrees I have to be there to lift the hood for a minute or two to cool it down. I never had to tend to the old grill like that. I still love this grill. It's small and fits into our motor home really well. And very good customer service.
Results.Title: Small Webber Grill

Results.ReviewText: This unit is portable, but yet has great heat distribution. It is easy to get grill marks on the entire cooking surface. It's small size means it heats up quick. We have cooked on it 10 times in the 2 weeks we have had it. It does a great job on chicken, burgers and hot dogs. It is surprisingly easy on the consumption of the small gas bottles which we were delisted with. This grill get higher marks than our Weber genesis.
Results.Title: Fantastic grill

Results.ReviewText: This IS the only portable grill anyone should consider!  We even use it on our motor yacht which is always in salt water... it is rust free.  No one had to settle for a Magma for boating.  The Weber 1200 is far superior to the Magma.  Steaks are grilled to perfection on the Weber 1200!  Love it!
Results.Title: Don’t settle for anything less!

Results.ReviewText: I finally broke down and bought this Weber Q Series as a Christmas present for our RV. We decided to do a test run on it before hand just to make sure we understood the operation. I bought some awesome New York strips from our butcher. Heated the Weber up to 500°, and slapped the steaks on. The sear marks were beautiful. The steaks perfectly cooked to 145° internal. They were so juicy and flavorful. We new we had a winner right away!
Results.Title: Great for the RV!

Results.ReviewText: My wife and I are full time RVers and we do a lot more stuff outside, but not as much cooking because of the size and weight of our last grill.  Now that we have the Q 1200 I am cooking outside all the time.  Love the temp sensor and how it cooks evenly.  Oh and a grease catcher.  Happy camper.
Results.Title: Great Q!

Results.ReviewText: Disappointed, It is burning everything, even on low, and I am an experienced griller. Was hoping there was some sort of regulator adjustment, but apparently not.  Why would you make a grill so hot you have to cook things up on pans to get the food away from the heat. What is the purpose of having a medium and a high, when everything burns on low. I have been a Weber user for years, this is not what I expected from a Weber product.  Would suggest you fix the problem, instead of trying these work-arounds.

Results.ReviewText: I have been using this for about a year.  It is solidly built.  My only criticism is that the heat is not easily controlled.  basically it is either "on or Off".  I would also like to see it get to sear temperature quicker.   It takes a good 15 minutes to reach anything over 500 degrees.   It is also a little temperamental on a windy day.   You need to build a little wall around it.
Results.Title: Well built

Results.ReviewText: Still new to cooking on this grill, the problems i have found so far is if its windy very hard to keep the temperature a the correct level, also takes a very long time to heat up to clean when first being used. I have only used on a small tank, have not bought the stand and larger tank yet. This might relieve these concerns, but I am unsure. Definitely well built just cant give it 5 stars due to its issues I have had out of the box.
Results.Title: Step above an average grill
